quarterly_data.signal: DCI scale and demand: CFO Csaba Sverha: 'our DCI business reached close to a billion-dollar run rate. If you look at our Q4 numbers, our DCI business was equivalent to our historical Datacom business. So that's a meaningful growth and continues to grow.' CEO Seamus Grady: in DCI 'we have really all the main players', and for DCI and transceivers 'the demand is just insatiable'; the transceiver business, historically the main customer, now layers merchant and hyperscale-direct growth vectors on top.
quarterly_data.figure: DCI close to a billion-dollar run rate; Q4 DCI business equivalent to the historical Datacom business

quarterly_data.signal: Building 10 status and expansion stance: CEO Seamus Grady: 'We have already started to produce in some of, just started to produce in some of Building 10. The vast bulk of that capacity add is in front of us.' Fabrinet expands capacity ahead of demand, calls investing in capacity 'a very important use of the cash', and is 'going to be continuing to expand aggressively over the next few years.' The Santa Clara operations (Fabrinet West) are primarily focused on helping customers bring new products to market; since Fabrinet West is 'an on-ramp to Bangkok', success there is measured by how efficiently production transfers to Thailand for higher-volume, low-cost manufacturing.
